item.title: URI trustees OK 3.5% tuition hike, higher fees
item.description: Both in-state and out-of-state students attending the University of Rhode Island will see a 3.5% tuition increase next academic year under a proposal approved at a Feb. 13 meeting of the school’s board of trustees. item.title: SENEDIA gets $195K grant from Real Jobs RI for Defense Partnership Program
item.description: MIDDLETOWN – SENEDIA has received a $195,500 grant from Real Jobs RI to continue its Defense Partnership Program, the workforce development organization announced Wednesday. The partnership program connects job seekers with hiring, internship and training opportunities in the state’s $7.6 billion defense industry. item.title: State awards additional $233K to combat homelessness
item.description: PROVIDENCE – An additional $233,350 in state funding has been awarded to support three efforts to combat homelessness this winter, Gov. Daniel J. McKee and the R.I. Executive Office of Housing announced Wednesday. These awards build on the McKee administration’s previous $1.8 million investment in winter preparedness, which expanded emergency shelter capacity statewide, established low-barrier emergency pop-up sites, […]

item.title: Abouzeid returns to WPRI as vice president and general manager
item.description: PROVIDENCE – Joseph Abouzeid has been named vice president and general manager of WPRI-TV CBS 12, Nexstar Media Group Inc. confirmed on Wednesday. Abouzeid succeeds Patrick Wholey, who now heads Nexstar’s Washington D.C. affiliate, WDCW-TV CW 50, per company spokesman Gary Weitman.
